message.content:
**Moderna, Inc. (CIK 1682852) — product sales trend for COVID and RSV vaccines, FY2022–FY2024**

**Net product sales by product (USD millions, years ended Dec. 31; 2024 Form 10-K, Note 3 "Net Product Sales", chunk 1682852/mrna-20241231:537600):**

| Product | 2024 | 2023 | 2022 |
|---|---|---|---|
| COVID (Spikevax) | $3,084 | $6,671 | $18,435 |
| RSV (mRESVIA) | $25 | — | — |
| **Total net product sales** | **$3,109** | **$6,671** | **$18,435** |

**Total revenue (consolidated, USD):** $19,263 million for FY2022 (fact id 2606780, accession 0001682852-25-000022, end 2022-12-31); $6,848 million for FY2023 (fact id 2606789, same accession); $3,236 million for FY2024 (fact id 2606798, accession 0001682852-25-000022, end 2024-12-31). The gap between total revenue and product sales is "other revenue" (grants, collaborations, etc.).

**Trend (calculations performed with the calculate tool):**
- COVID product sales fell 63.8% in 2023 (from $18,435M to $6,671M) and a further 53.8% in 2024 (to $3,084M) — a cumulative decline of roughly 83% over two years.
